name: chatchat
description: Local-first AI Council: you ask, they debate.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:web
scripts.check: npm run check:core && npm run check:web && npm run check:extension
scripts.check:extension: node --check extension/catalog.js && node --check extension/coalitions.js && node --check extension/council.js && node --check extension/content-script.js && node --check extension/service-worker.js && node --check extension/sidepanel.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8')); console.log('✓ ChatChat extension manifest valid')"
scripts.test: npm run build:core && node dist/tests/core.test.js && node dist/tests/provider-sdk.test.js && node dist/tests/teach-mode.test.js && node dist/tests/test-speech.test.js && node dist/tests/council-bridge.test.js && node dist/tests/window-health.test.js && node dist/tests/gate-b-proof.test.js && node tests/extension-council.test.js && node tests/house-coalitions.test.js
